title: Can I switch hotels? My partner is joining.

boundaries.note: Planning evidence from a REPLAY hotel.search recording for the requested replacement property's location

request.utterance: Can I switch hotels? My partner is joining.

assert.description: the structured stay-change request is accepted
the request is classified as a stay change
the request carries binding instruction authority
a recovery case opens for the request
the declared replacement property becomes an authoritative stay preference
the partner's occupancy is recorded from the target, not defaulted

assert.expected: funding declaration TRAVELLER_FUNDED recorded; no temporal anchor derivable from target
assert.description: funding stays honest: with no cost anchor the allocation is deferred to authority, never assumed

assert.expected: funding allocation UNKNOWN: no temporal anchor in target
assert.description: the missing funding anchor is recorded as UNKNOWN, never converted into certainty

steps.description: Planning loop issues the occupancy-aware hotel.search (REPLAY evidence) and records stay-change status honestly

assert.description: the planning loop runs an evidence round and a concluding round
the declared stay change drives a real hotel.search evidence request
the REPLAY recording for the replacement property's location resolves
the recorded Downtown Core market evidence flows through normalization (174 properties, 520 rates)
candidate replacement stays are enumerated from the recorded hotel-market evidence
the cheapest candidate names the property, never a raw offer id
every candidate carries a deterministic viability verdict
the evidence gate and every declared stay dimension are recorded as explicit uncertainty

assert.expected: replacement/extension options must be searched before any strategy is proposed
assert.description: the evidence-gated strategy boundary is stated honestly
the declared property preference is recorded, not silently dropped
the partner occupancy is recorded, not defaulted away
the case remains open in PLANNING — stay-change execution is not silently performed
the case belongs to the requesting traveller's trip
the case read model resolves the traveller identity from seeded programme state
the deterministic arrival-before-commitment check still passes through the stay change
